summary: Nano Labs Ltd filed a Form 6-K, the foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US current report, furnishing its interim results for the period ended June 30, 2026 (Q2/first half). The excerpt contains only XBRL tagging data covering revenue, customer and supplier concentration, tax jurisdictions, and stock-option/share-incentive-plan vesting schedules; no transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event is disclosed. This is a routine periodic reporting filing rather than a special situation, so no deal terms apply. Watch for ordinary operating, concentration, and dilution trends in future filings.
